## RedtatoWords 0.9.9

First public build. Everything below is new.

### Getting started

On first launch the app walks you through two screens:

1. **Welcome & sign-in** — sign in to your account first. Working signed-in
   noticeably reduces the chance of being rate-limited, so this step is required.
2. **Guided tour** — seven short clips, one per feature. Each clip loops until you
   move on. You can skip it and re-open it any time from **Help**.

### Highlights

- **Candidate list** — collects suggestions through two independent channels
  (network responses and page rendering) and merges them into one de-duplicated list.
- **TAG cloud** — segments every candidate automatically, de-duplicates the parts and
  ranks them by frequency. Multi-select tags to expand the next round.
- **Round timeline** — every round is kept. Jump back to any earlier round at any time.
- **Drag to combine** — drag one tag onto another to build a combined tag.
- **Batch mode** — feed several search terms at once and merge all results into one list.
- **Export** — copy everything, or export to TXT / CSV / Excel / JSON.
- **Achievements** — five hidden ones. The entry point only appears once you earn your first.
- **Update check** — checks quietly on startup and only speaks up when a new version
  exists. You can also check manually from *Settings*.
- **Fully local** — no account, no telemetry, nothing leaves your machine.

  Choose **More info → Run anyway**.
- macOS builds are published in a follow-up release.
